name: Vikki Goodwin
summary: Vikki Ann Goodwin (born May 18, 1967) is an American politician who is the lieutenant governor-elect of Texas. A member of the Democratic Party, she has represented the 47th district in the Texas House of Representatives since 2019. After securing her party's nomination for lieutenant governor in the 2026 election, Goodwin defeated incumbent Lieutenant Governor Dan Patrick on November 3.
